description: This Java class implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering cached sub-content within the OFBiz content management system. It manages content retrieval, rendering, and editing link generation within Freemarker templates.

classes.name: RenderSubContentCacheTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class for rendering cached sub-content in OFBiz, handling content retrieval, rendering, and edit link generation.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a custom Writer that renders sub-content within a Freemarker template, managing content fetching, rendering, and optional editing links.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Handles the actual rendering of the content or edit link within the custom Writer.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the opening HTML for an editable content block.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the closing HTML and an edit link for the content block.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS style class for the edit link, defaulting if not specified.
